mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vectors ( reference_id, reference_table, chunk_index, content, metadata, embedding_vector ) VALUES ( #{referenceId}, #{referenceTable}, COALESCE(#{chunkIndex}, 0), #{text}, #{metadata}, #{embeddingVector, typeHandler=io.github.gyulbbe.common.utils.embeddingVector.FloatArrayTypeHandler} )
mapper.select:
SELECT reference_id, reference_table, chunk_index, content, metadata, embedding_vector, VECTOR_DISTANCE(embedding_vector, #{queryVector, typeHandler=io.github.gyulbbe.common.utils.embeddingVector.FloatArrayTypeHandler}, COSINE) as distance FROM vectors
embedding_vector IS NOT NULL
AND reference_table = #{referenceTable}
ORDER BY distance FETCH FIRST #{topK} ROWS ONLY
